name: Control surface (the app on the API, MCP and CLI)
description: Puts the app on the API, MCP and CLI (build apps-control-surface, Brett Nov 3 2026: "Put EVERY app on the API, MCP and CLI"). While the app is open it reports its catalog (every screen, dialog, settings tab and sub-tab, and every registered action, plugins' too, from its own search index) to the control surface broker on the console server, keeps a stream open, and runs the console-command@1 messages it is sent through its own runtime: open a screen, a dialog or a settings tab, run an action under its own policy, go back or home, close a dialog; then acks what it did. A Claude session says `app_show {app, target}` and the app goes there. Inside a host (Molly) it reports the host and whether its frame is in front, and asks to be brought forward before it runs a command. Settings → Plugins → Remote control: on / off for this device and a note per command. Transport: the console's /api/console with the browser's own hub session by default, or the app's own proxy (AmberX forwards through its server). Core: framework/core/engines/console-commands.mjs. Built Nov 4 2026 (Fable).

params.label: Control surface broker
params.help: The console server that keeps the app's clients and delivers commands. https only (http only for localhost).
